_readme: v3 chef animations. Swap art by replacing frames in assets/chef_v3/<state>/ (named 00.png, 01.png, …) and updating 'count' here. 'flip' mirrors a state horizontally in-game. States are referenced by name from v3/app.js.

walk_right.note: Walking to the right / along a row.

walk_left.note: Walking left — mirrored from walk_right in-game until dedicated art exists.

walk_up.note: Walking up a column (PLACEHOLDER: reuses side walk; needs real up art).

walk_down.note: Walking down a column (PLACEHOLDER: reuses side walk; needs real down art).

carry.note: Walking while carrying the basket (PLACEHOLDER: reuses walk; needs a basket pose).

pick.note: Reaching to pick an item up (PLACEHOLDER: currently the book-read frames; needs a real reach/grab).

stir.note: Stirring the pot on the stove.

read_book.note: Reading the recipe book (the real meaning of the old 'interaction' frames).
